Yes — [1] is the matching paper: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation [1]. It proposes Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf) to help small models do continual post-training by providing in-distribution supervision without relying on strong in-context learning or instruction-following abilities [1].

[1] focuses on small-model continual learning and says SynthSelf consistently outperforms several distillation methods across multiple small model scales and benchmarks [1].
